heading: Camshaft Timing Oil Control Valve
text:
SF-46
SF! -- CAMSHAFT TIMING OIL CONTROL VALVE
CAMSHAFT TIMING OIL CONTROL
VALVE
ON-VEHICLE INSPECTION
INSPECT OIL CONTROL VALVE RESISTANCE
(a) Remove the No. 2 cylinder head cover.
(b) 2ZZ-GE:
Disconnect the 2 PCV hoses.
(c) Disconnect the oil control va!ve connector.
(d) Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between the
terminals.
Resistance: 6.9- 7.9 n at 20 °C (68 °F)
If the resistance is not as specified, replace the valve.
(e) Reconnect the oil control valve connector.
(f} Reinstall the V-bank cover.
